decisions.reasoning: The only failing gate-level finding right now is picture_area (finding id "picture_area"): the recorded picture is 1920×1080 inside a 2560×1440 file at offset +320+180 — it is padded/pillarboxed and must be cropped before any composite can be rendered. The fix.reframe strategy explicitly addresses "picture_area" and "subject_size", and subject_size is already passing (p50 0.346, p95 0.359 vs the 0.55 cap) and distance is steady (1.05× vs the 1.35 threshold), so the reframe only needs to strip the padding. All other gate-relevant findings — pose_coverage 1.0 (≥0.6 pass), one_subject 1.0 (≥0.95 pass), headroom within bounds — are healthy. face_exposure is a warn (clamped at ×1.25), not a failing gate. No verification has been run yet (latest_verification is null) and no fixes have been applied, so the retry budget of 2 is untouched. If fix.reframe fails to resolve picture_area, the next step would be to inspect or, if the framing solve cannot satisfy the profile bounds, reshoot with the "Export without padding" guidance.

The fix.reframe has already been applied and all pre-process findings are passing: pose_coverage is 1.0 (gate requires ≥0.6), one_subject is 1.0 (gate requires ≥0.95), subject_size p50 is 0.346 and p95 is 0.359 (gate cap 0.55), picture_area fills the recorded picture, distance_steady is 1.05× (gate ≤1.35), and headroom is clean. The face_exposure finding is a warn (value 1.25, clamped at the 1.25 bound) — this is a recorded-content limit noted for the report, not a gate defect that can be fixed. No gate has failed yet; latest_verification is null because no process attempt has been made. The correct next step is a first process render using process.standard, which is the standard strategy for a first attempt. The retry budget is 2 reprocesses used 0. If process.standard produces a failed verification on the separation gate, process.separation_targeted is available as a retry. If the budget is spent with gates still failing, the honest exit is reshoot with the separation and face_exposure guidance.

The latest verification for attempt_1 (process.standard) passed every single gate: pose_coverage is 1.0 (gate ≥ 0.6), one_subject is 1.0 (gate ≥ 0.95), matte_extent is 1.003 (gate ≥ 0.9), separation is 2.9 (gate ≥ 1.5), head_spread is 0.007 (gate ≤ 0.02), head_drift is 1.2 px (gate ≤ 4.0 px), frame_count is 1285 = 1285, and audio_md5 is equal. All 8 gates are green. The face_exposure finding is a warning (recorded-content limit), not a gate failure, so it does not block delivery. There is nothing left to fix or re-process; the honest and correct action is to deliver.
